verdict.rationale: Jules exposes an API (jules-docs-9, jules-docs-16) that lets developers create custom workflows and send tasks programmatically, including API keys for automation (jules-docs-10) and an automationMode field for PR creation (jules-docs-11), which supports headless/scripted invocation. A community user confirms building a personal integration (MCP server) that dispatches tasks via the API (jules-comm-19). However, there's no explicit documentation or example of a CLI tool, official CI/CD integration, or shell-script-friendly invocation pattern—everything centers on cloud VM execution triggered via web app, GitHub labels, or API calls rather than a dedicated headless CI mode. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline integration docs, official CLI for shell scripting, example of running in automated build pipelines without human review step.
